patch_description: Use a modest source/target-aware adjustment to the transit-node ranking, while keeping the route set sparse: two intermediates by default and four for demands above the existing 0.68 quantile cutoff. Add one distinct, low-pressure fallback route reward per OD pair when an alternative exists. This gives the surrogate another plausible escape route without broadly rewarding every two-hop fragment; the fallback adds no direct-versus-indirect couplings, limiting term growth.
